# Final Execution Plan — First Safe Reconstruction Wave

The Awtsmoos gives clarity by placing each vessel in its proper measure and time;
Awtsmoos.com will keep every true search power while answer, context, and identity cease competing for the same prime.

## Approved Production Write Set

Only these six production files are approved for the first implementation pass. Every one will be rewritten completely; no partial patching is permitted.

### 1. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/index.html`

Rewrite the full 61-line entry document.

- Preserve every existing stylesheet/script dependency unless a current read disproves it.
- Preserve `search-skip-link` and its target.
- Preserve all runtime-required IDs consumed by `searchDom.js`.
- Preserve scope links and result containers.
- Keep identity text but compact the hero markup and remove decorative orbital markup if it no longer serves the task.
- Wrap the existing lane/history/help discovery rail in native `<details class="library-context">` with a concise `<summary>`.
- Keep context content in normal source order after the result region.

### 2. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/hero.css`

Rewrite the full current file.

- Compact the 19rem billboard into a shallow identity masthead.
- Expand every currently compressed one-line rule into readable multiline CSS.
- Keep the kicker and scope-navigation responsibilities already owned here.
- Remove visual dependence on decorative hero-mark geometry.
- Reduce badge/card competition while preserving trustworthy explanatory copy.

### 3. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/layout.css`

Rewrite the full current file.

- Make the workspace result-first and single-column at the structural level.
- Keep result/status/empty/error layout ownership cohesive.
- Prevent long source content from forcing horizontal overflow.
- Keep the file below 120 lines without compressing rules.

### 4. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/discovery.css`

Rewrite the full current file.

- Style native `.library-context` and its summary.
- Keep closed state calm and opened context obviously secondary.
- Present the existing lane/history/help cards as a compact grid only when opened.
- Preserve existing card/header/button state semantics.

### 5. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/responsive.css`

Rewrite the full current file.

- Remove assumptions about a permanent desktop side rail.
- Preserve sensible tablet scope/form behavior.
- Add a short-height rule that disables sticky search pressure.
- Keep normal-flow fallback resilient.

### 6. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/mobile-context.css`

Rewrite the full current file.

- Remove the 86vw horizontal discovery-card carousel.
- Opened context becomes a normal one-column stack.
- Preserve touch, overflow, and safe reading behavior.

## Explicitly Preserved Production Files

No first-pass writes to `SearchApp.js`, `SearchControlDisclosure.js`, `searchDom.js`, search APIs, history logic, result rendering, `form.css`, `form-disclosure.css`, `shell.css`, or `mobile.css`. Their inspected responsibilities already support the target architecture.

No writes to Shema Strike, Ohrfront, Social Composer, Animator, MitzvahWorld, or runtime-quality tooling while concurrent agents own those surfaces.

## Execution Sequence

1. Refresh `git status --short -- geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim`.
2. Re-read all six approved production files in full immediately before mutation.
3. Rewrite all six complete files as one coherent source pass.
4. Re-read all six rewritten files in full.
5. Write `09_FIRST_PASS_READBACK_AND_DELTA.md`, comparing every original plan promise to actual source.
6. Only then run existing Sefarim tests and browser/runtime checks.
7. If any delta or regression exists, perform a second complete-file source pass, reread, retest, and document it.
8. After focused success, run the existing sitewide runtime auditor read-only to discover the next clean broken route families.

## Completion Evidence Required For This Wave

- Six complete-file writes witnessed and reread.
- Every touched source remains <=120 lines.
- No concurrent-file collision.
- Sefarim tests pass.
- Real `/mawgawl/sefarim/` route loads without site-owned console/static errors.
- Query/deep-link, Search Options, search submission, scope, context, lane, history, and clear-history behaviors remain functional.
- Desktop, tablet, 430px mobile, and short-height layouts have no accidental page overflow or sticky obstruction.

## NEXT_ACTION

Refresh scoped Git status and reread the exact six approved files before the first production write pass.
